NewsArticle.Title: The Eulogy: Invocation & Conclusion
NewsArticle.Content: Jean, [who provided lore of Mehadi Flowers during The Pact,](http://www.darkages.com/news/991029.html) writes about the Invocation: Three unique Eulogies were held. One by the Grimlok of Pravat to their Goddess. One by the Kobolds of Astrid to their Goddess. And one by the Mukul of Mehadi to their Goddess. Each priest welcomes Aisling worshippers to offer their Eulogy until their Closing Rite, when the priests will return to their native villages. All three were held exactly eight years after the Great Sacrifice of Danaan. Some theologians speculate that a rite yet-to-be performed when the stars are righlty aligned, the combined relics that appeared to the devotees, and--most importantly--faith will invoke the Goddess Who Sacrificed Herself. Jean Councilor of Loures ((Closing Rite: 99.11.29 2 p.m. PST))
